author: Gmelin, 1789
summary: 봄과 가을에 한반도 전역을 드물지 않게 지나가는 나그네새이다. 홀로 또는 암수가 함께 주로 나무 위에서 지내고 땅에 내려오는 일은 드물며, 날아다니는 곤충과 거미를 주로 먹는다. 아고산대 숲속에 둥지를 틀고 한배에 알 3~5개를 낳는다. 시베리아 남부, 알타이 동부, 몽골 북부, 만주, 아무르, 우수리, 사할린, 일본, 캄차카, 쿠릴 열도 등지에서 번식하고 중국 동·남부, 타이완, 하이난섬, 인도차이나, 태국 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Dark-sided Flycatcher (Muscicapa sibirica), adult (sexes alike) on spring or autumn passage: crown, nape, back, rump and uppertail coverts dusky grey-brown, the tail darker brown; lores pale grey with buffy-white feathering and a neat whitish eye-ring; cheeks and ear coverts dull grey-brown with a dark malar stripe; chin and centre of the throat white, the white extending as a pale half-collar onto the neck sides; breast and flanks heavily smudged with broad, diffuse dusky grey-brown streaks, the breast often looking almost wholly dark; lower belly and undertail coverts white; wings dark brown with narrow pale edges to the tertials; small blackish-brown bill with a tiny pale base to the lower mandible; brown iris; thin, short dark grey legs.
art.pose: perched on a branch high in a tree, side view
art.scene: Korean woodland canopy during spring or autumn migration; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched upright on a bare twig: dusky grey-brown upperparts, whitish eye-ring, long wingtips reaching well down the short tail, dark smudged breast and flanks, white undertail coverts, thin dark legs
adult, front view: white chin and centre of the throat with a pale half-collar, dark malar stripes, breast almost wholly dusky grey-brown, broad diffuse streaks on the flanks, white lower belly
art.build: Small, compact flycatcher, slightly smaller than a sparrow, with a large rounded head, short neck and upright stance on an exposed twig. Bill small and short, broad at the base, much shorter than the head and almost all dark. Legs short and thin. Wings long: at rest the primaries extend far beyond the tertials and reach about two-thirds of the way down the short square tail. Sallies out after flying insects and returns to the same perch.
avoid: Do not paint crisp, narrow dark streaks on clean white underparts — that is Grey-streaked Flycatcher (Muscicapa griseisticta).
Do not paint a larger bill with a broad pale base and plain pale grey underparts — that is Asian Brown Flycatcher (Muscicapa dauurica).
Do not give it wing bars, a supercilium or any yellow or orange colour.
Do not paint short wings; the long primaries reach well down the tail.
